newsitem.title: CHINA: Sihanouk supports ASEAN stand on Cambodia - Alatas.
newsitem.headline: Sihanouk supports ASEAN stand on Cambodia - Alatas.

text.p: Cambodian King Sihanouk has expressed support for ASEAN's position on a political crisis in Phnom Penh, Indonesian Foreign Minister Ali Alatas said after an audience with the Southeast Asian monarch on Thursday.
"We came away from the meeting with his Majesty the King encouraged by his understanding and full support for our position," Alatas told reporters in Beijing.
Alatas, Thai Foreign Minister Prachuab Chaiyasarn and Philippines Foreign Minister Domingo Siazon met the king at his palatial residence in Beijing.

The ministers met Sihanouk to express the views of Association of South East Asian Nations (ASEAN) on the Cambodian political situation and to solicit his opinions on how ASEAN could help to resolve it, Alatas said.

He declined to give details of how ASEAN hoped to help or of the views voiced by Sihanouk, who reigns but does not rule in Cambodia and who has asked that the content of his meetings with international envoys be kept secret.

ASEAN last week postponed the entry of Cambodia into the grouping in the wake of First Prime Minister Prince Norodom Ranariddh's overthrow by co-prime minister Hun Sen. Alatas and the other foreign ministers are scheduled to meet Ranariddh in Bangkok on Friday and with Hun Sen in Cambodia on Saturday.
